name: brand-studio
description: The full creative cycle of brand creation and visual identity, from briefing to manual, as five interlinked skills sharing one project state. brand-studio is the orchestrator (context: fork): a nine-step state machine with gates that need evidence, review verdicts, approval, and change propagation that marks every downstream step stale when an earlier one reopens, plus a pt/en router that reads the state. brand-discovery finds gaps, contradictions and impossible timelines in a brief and maps the competitive category in OKLCH. brand-direction screens names, validates anatomy, builds accessible colour families that block vetoed hues, and tallies the client's vote with quorum and a double count. brand-review lints deliverables and reads them through the client's eyes. brand-system checks guidelines for gaps and numbers that contradict each other and file names. Connects to brand-reverse by data. 11 stdlib scripts with typed exit codes, 10 references with per-claim confidence levels, 4 agents, 4 commands.
